caption: The drawing displays three depictions of a ruffled, leafy object resembling a botanical specimen, possibly a type of seaweed or lichen, against a light beige background. The upper portion of the drawing features a large, central, colored illustration shaded in light green and highlighted with fine black lines and stippling to represent surface texture and curled, uneven margins with wavy outlines and intricate edge details. Some small, rounded clumps or structures are present along the edges and surfaces. Below this main subject, there are two smaller, uncolored line drawings on the right side. These lower sketches show the object from different angles or stages, rendered with only pencil or ink lines, focusing on the outline and some inner surface markings, with less detail and no shading or color. The overall composition places the primary colored drawing near the top middle, while the two line drawings are stacked vertically toward the lower right quadrant of the page.
title: Hat
